hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Nawada Metro

negative_snippets:
Dirty room . Rude staff , especially the receptionist. Hotel is totally different from what is shows in pics.  Very old and damage construction. The name of Hotel is Moody INN.
Even though my booking was fully prepaid, the hotel staff demanded extra payment at check-in. When I called OYO customer support, it took over 40 minutes to resolve the issue — total waste of time.
No TV in the room.No wifi. No drinking water.
Dirty bedsheets and broken switchboards
AC and fan not working properly
Bathroom taps damaged and no water supply.

Never book this property — not worth the money or hassle.

My recent stay at this OYO property was extremely disappointing.
Even though my booking was fully prepaid, the hotel staff demanded extra payment at check-in. When I called OYO customer support, it took over 35 minutes to resolve the issue — total waste of time.

The room condition was terrible:

No TV in the room

Dirty bedsheets and broken switchboards

AC and fan not working properly

Bathroom taps damaged and no water supply

When I complained, the staff rudely replied, “Aisa hi hai bhaiya.”

The staff’s behavior was unprofessional and rude, and the hotel failed to meet even basic standards of cleanliness or comfort.
I strongly advise others to avoid this property — not worth the money or hassle.

Rooms were so messy and dirty, the pictures shown in the application was totally fake. Totally unsatisfied with the service even bedshee were so dirty and smelly, no handwash in washroom multiple times asking for the handwash but staff didnot responds properly and there are rats in the room.
